sheets.noticed: A black map with a bold red 'MONARCH MIGRATION' title. Bold and hooky.
A red route drops down to 'SOUTHERN CANADA'. The journey starts.
The red line traces the trip south. The movement keeps me in.
A curved red route appears over the map as 'up to four thousand kilometers' is said.
An arc across the map labelled 'UP TO 4,000 KM'. The journey is clear now.
The route reaches 'central Mexico'. The map is the same, but it is still moving.
A yellow sticky 'None of them has ever been there'. A strong hook.
The sticky note holds while the narration builds. The twist keeps me.
'Their great-grandparents made the last trip' on a sticky, with a dot moving along the route. I am hooked.
The route animates again under the same sticky. The clip ends here and I am still watching.

remembers: Every autumn monarch butterflies fly up to 4,000 km from southern Canada to the same mountain forests in central Mexico. None of the ones making the trip have ever been there; their great-grandparents made the last trip.
